constraint buckets.buckets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint buckets_analytics.buckets_analytics_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint buckets_vectors.buckets_vectors_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint iceberg_namespaces.iceberg_namespaces_catalog_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (catalog_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets_analytics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint iceberg_namespaces.iceberg_namespaces_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint iceberg_tables.iceberg_tables_catalog_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (catalog_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets_analytics(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint iceberg_tables.iceberg_tables_namespace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (namespace_id) REFERENCES storage.iceberg_namespaces(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint iceberg_tables.iceberg_tables_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint migrations.migrations_name_key UNIQUE (name)
constraint migrations.migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint objects.objects_bucketId_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bucket_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets(id)
constraint objects.objects_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint s3_multipart_uploads.s3_multipart_uploads_bucket_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bucket_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets(id)
constraint s3_multipart_uploads.s3_multipart_uploads_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint s3_multipart_uploads_parts.s3_multipart_uploads_parts_bucket_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bucket_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets(id)
constraint s3_multipart_uploads_parts.s3_multipart_uploads_parts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
constraint s3_multipart_uploads_parts.s3_multipart_uploads_parts_upload_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (upload_id) REFERENCES storage.s3_multipart_uploads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraint vector_indexes.vector_indexes_bucket_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (bucket_id) REFERENCES storage.buckets_vectors(id)
constraint vector_indexes.vector_indexes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
enum buckettype STANDARD,ANALYTICS,VECTOR

function list_objects_with_delimiter(_bucket_id text, prefix_param text, delimiter_param text, max_keys integer DEFAULT 100, start_after text DEFAULT ''::text, next_token text DEFAULT ''::text, sort_order text DEFAULT 'asc'::text) returns TABLE(name text, id uuid, metadata jsonb, updated_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, last_accessed_at timestamp with time zone) s

function protect_delete() returns trigger v

function update_updated_at_column() returns trigger v
index CREATE INDEX idx_multipart_uploads_list ON storage.s3_multipart_uploads USING btree (bucket_id, key, created_at)
index CREATE INDEX idx_objects_bucket_id_name ON storage.objects USING btree (bucket_id, name COLLATE "C")
index CREATE INDEX idx_objects_bucket_id_name_lower ON storage.objects USING btree (bucket_id, lower(name) COLLATE "C")
index CREATE INDEX name_prefix_search ON storage.objects USING btree (name text_pattern_ops)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bname ON storage.buckets USING btree (name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bucketid_objname ON storage.objects USING btree (bucket_id, name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buckets_analytics_pkey ON storage.buckets_analytics USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buckets_analytics_unique_name_idx ON storage.buckets_analytics USING btree (name) WHERE (deleted_at IS NULL)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buckets_pkey ON storage.buckets USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX buckets_vectors_pkey ON storage.buckets_vectors USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX iceberg_namespaces_pkey ON storage.iceberg_namespaces USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX iceberg_tables_pkey ON storage.iceberg_tables USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_iceberg_namespaces_bucket_id ON storage.iceberg_namespaces USING btree (catalog_id, name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_iceberg_tables_location ON storage.iceberg_tables USING btree (location)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_iceberg_tables_namespace_id ON storage.iceberg_tables USING btree (catalog_id, namespace_id, name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX migrations_name_key ON storage.migrations USING btree (name)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX migrations_pkey ON storage.migrations USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX objects_pkey ON storage.objects USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX s3_multipart_uploads_parts_pkey ON storage.s3_multipart_uploads_parts USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX s3_multipart_uploads_pkey ON storage.s3_multipart_uploads USING btree (id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX vector_indexes_name_bucket_id_idx ON storage.vector_indexes USING btree (name, bucket_id)
index CREATE UNIQUE INDEX vector_indexes_pkey ON storage.vector_indexes USING btree (id)
rls buckets on
rls buckets_analytics on
rls buckets_vectors on
rls iceberg_namespaces on
rls iceberg_tables on
rls migrations on
rls objects on
rls s3_multipart_uploads on
rls s3_multipart_uploads_parts on
rls vector_indexes on
trigger CREATE TRIGGER enforce_bucket_name_length_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF name ON storage.buckets FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.enforce_bucket_name_length()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER protect_buckets_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.buckets FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER protect_objects_delete BEFORE DELETE ON storage.objects FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.protect_delete()
trigger CREATE TRIGGER update_objects_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON storage.objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION storage.update_updated_at_column()
